verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents 'Rudder AI', an AI-powered agent in Slack for managing/interacting with the workspace, plus AI/MCP features letting users delegate tasks in natural language (debug delivery errors, write/test transformations, review audit logs, detect duplicate events) with root-cause analysis and citations. This shows a genuine built-in AI assistant capability, though the MCP-based agentic features actually run through external clients (Claude, Cursor, etc.) rather than a fully self-contained in-product assistant, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of the Slack agent's real-world task delegation. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Rudder AI in Slack actually completing delegated tasks, clarity on whether Slack agent operates fully in-product vs. relying on MCP/external LLM.
